stanzas: En tu azul cielo, en tus auras,
En tus montes y en tu mar,
Tu pabellón que en las lides
Tierra de dichas, del sol y amores,
En tu regazo dulce es vivir.
Es una gloria para tus hijos,
Cuando te ofenden, por ti morir.
orig.credit: José Palma, "Filipinas" (1899); the Spanish text as quoted in Wikipedia's article (Spanish Wikipedia)

stanzas: Daughter of the sun of the East,
In your blue sky, in your breezes,
In your mountains and in your sea,
Your flag, which in the battles
Land of joys, of sun and loves,
In your lap it is sweet to live.
It is a glory for your children,
When they wrong you, to die for you.

notes: line 2.4: 'hollar', to trample or tread on.
line 5.4: 'Cuando te ofenden', when they (enemies) offend or wrong you.
